text: Cultivating plants offers personal satisfaction while stabilizing the environment around your home. Vegetable scraps and garden debris decompose through composting to generate nutrient-dense soil. Waste volume drops and long-term fertilizer becomes available as a result of this breakdown process. Mulch applied to planting areas inhibits weed growth, preserves water levels, and moderates ground temperature. Utilizing both compost and mulch together establishes a resilient, self-supporting garden system.
